name: The Dark Field
storyline:
Ahmed Raked is an unemployed man whose story begins with a mysterious message promising a high-paying job at a remote farm.

It all seemed simple... until strange things began to happen.

You are given tasks that appear normal, but something unusual hides beneath the surface. The photos on the walls seem strangely familiar, your daily duties slowly turn into riddles, and the faces you encounter feel like you've seen them before. Your phone is your only guide in this place. The deeper you go, the closer you get to the great secret hidden behind this farm.

Each frame hides a clue... gather them to understand the bigger picture
summary: After receiving a strange message, Ahmed Raked finds himself at a remote farm with nothing but his phone to guide him. What starts as a simple job slowly twists into a dark, personal mystery—one that may be rooted deep in his past. Some jobs are more than they seem.
